extensionDescription.message: Extension to select text on web pages and mark with colors

popupDescription.message: Select text on web pages and use the control UI to highlight.

exportAllTooltip.message: Export all highlights to JSON file

importOverwriteConfirm.message: Some pages already have highlights. Existing highlights for those pages will be deleted and replaced with imported data. Proceed?

importUnsafeUrlSkipped.message: $1 page(s) with invalid or unsafe URLs were skipped.

importAllUnsafeUrl.message: No pages could be imported because all URLs are invalid or unsafe.

importAllInvalidSchema.message: No pages could be imported because all data failed schema validation.

importSchemaInvalidItemsSkipped.message: $1 invalid item(s) were skipped during import.

noHighlights.message: No highlighted text on this page.

showControlsOnSelection.message: Show Control UI on Text Selection

confirmClearAll.message: Really delete all highlights on this page?

confirmDeletePage.message: Delete all highlights for this page?

refresh.description: Button text for refreshing the highlighted pages list

shortcutHint.message: Key combinations can be changed in browser shortcut settings (Chrome: chrome://extensions/shortcuts, Firefox: about:addons).

colorChangeWarning.message: Changes do not affect existing highlights.

cloudSyncIntro.message: Sync highlights across devices via an encrypted cloud backup, for platforms (like Firefox for Android) where browser sync isn't available. Your data is encrypted on this device before upload; the sync code is the only way to decrypt it.

cloudSyncPairCodePlaceholder.message: Enter sync code from another device

cloudSyncInvalidCode.message: That sync code doesn't look right. Double-check it and try again.

cloudSyncSaveCodeWarning.message: Save this code somewhere safe. If you lose it, this data cannot be recovered.

cloudSyncCopyFailed.message: Couldn't copy automatically. The code is now shown above - please copy it manually.

cloudSyncResetConfirm.message: This disconnects this device and permanently forgets the sync code. Continue?

cloudSyncPagesExcludedNotice.message: ($1 older page(s) excluded due to the size limit)
cloudSyncPagesExcludedNotice.description: Appended to the last-synced status when the oldest pages were dropped from the cloud sync upload to fit the size limit. $1 is the number of excluded pages.

jumpToHighlight.message: Go to this highlight on the page

highlightNotFoundOnPage.message: Could not find this highlight on the page.

highlightMissingOnPage.description: Shown on a popup highlight entry whose text could not be located in the current page.

retryFindHighlight.description: Button on a popup highlight entry that asks the page to search for that highlight again.

retryFindHighlightFailed.message: Still not found. The page content may have changed.
retryFindHighlightFailed.description: Shown when the retry search still could not locate the highlight.

onboardingIntro.message: Marks lets you highlight text on any web page and finds it again the next time you visit. Here is everything it can do.

onboardingCreateBody.message: Select text on a page and a highlighter icon appears next to it. Click the icon to open the color palette, then pick a color.

onboardingEditTitle.message: Change the color or remove it

onboardingEditBody.message: Click an existing highlight to bring up its controls. From there you can switch its color or delete it.

onboardingContextMenuBody.message: Select text and right-click to highlight straight from the context menu, without using the icon.

onboardingShortcutsBody.message: Five shortcut slots highlight the selected text right away. Slots 1 to 4 come with Ctrl+Shift+1 through 4 (Command+Shift on macOS); slot 5 has no key until you assign one. Which color each slot uses is set in Settings.

onboardingMinimapBody.message: Marks along the right edge of the page show where your highlights are. Click one to jump to it. You can turn the minimap off in Settings.

onboardingManageBody.message: The toolbar icon lists the highlights on the current page - click one to scroll to it. The highlighted pages list collects every page you have highlighted, and lets you export or import them as a backup.

popupTipSelect.message: Select text on the page - a highlighter icon appears.

popupTipPick.message: Click the icon and choose a color.

popupTipManage.message: Click a highlight to change its color or remove it.
